paths.name: elastic_uniaxial

provenance.period: UNKNOWN time scale: no total_time, no declared scale, no deck period; using Abaqus's default step period 1.0
provenance.temperature: no temperature stated; TEMP=0 and DTEMP=0 (isothermal). A routine that reads TEMP as a field (e.g. non-local damage) sees zero
provenance.elastic: one decade below the registry activation_amplitude 0.0018 (Abaqus amplitude search on the original)
provenance.inelastic: 2 x registry activation_amplitude 0.0018; note the registry value is the amplitude the search settled on, which for a model that never activates is its probe amplitude, not a transition
provenance.finite: 0.2: kinematic requirement (>= 2% per experiment.MEANINGFUL_ACTIVATION['finite strain'], x10 so geometric terms exceed check tolerances)
provenance.model_domain: no documented time range (no deck periods, no un-ELSEd time chain in the source)

references.quantity: DDSDDE returned by the store OTI build
references.wrt: DSTRAN_j (engineering shear) or, for a gradient-driven source, the strain direction j pushed forward as dF = eps_j . F (Kirchhoff term added)
references.held_fixed: incoming STRESS_n, STATEV_n, STRAN_n, PROPS, TIME, DFGRD0 (and DFGRD1 for a DSTRAN-driven source)
references.scope: local: one increment from the recorded incoming state
references.reference: central FD of the ORIGINAL routine's STRESS_{n+1}, restored state
